data.current_description: Returns a 1–100 popularity score from the best available signal. When Apple censors a low direct value, an exact normalized term appearing before the full iPhone autocomplete query can conservatively raise the result to 6–10; it never lowers a stronger score or exceeds 10. Prefix and derived evidence are cached for 30 days independently from the eight-hour base popularity cache. A long cold prefix curve may finish in the background and affect a later request. A successful response costs one credit.
data.description_suggestion: Returns a 1–100 keyword popularity score based on App Store search signals. Accepts a keyword and optional storefront/platform parameters. Score calculation uses multiple signals: direct popularity data, normalized term matching, and cached prefix evidence. When Apple restricts direct data, the score may be conservatively estimated from normalized terms (range 6–10). Results are cached for 30 days (prefix/derived evidence) and 8 hours (base popularity). Background processing may update scores on subsequent requests for cold prefixes. A successful response costs one credit.
